title: VB3-16 interchange: export table row, events.jsonl, status=live (VB8-04)
description: Mirrors tools/bm_vault_export.py's build_events() output for a state["live"] row exactly (bm_vault_events.fold()'s own live shape, plus the status column build_events adds). THIS IS A DIFFERENT SHAPE from the plain event record in event.schema.json: fold() replays a stream of raw events down to one WINNER per ref, and the exported row carries only the winner's resolved fields (root_event_key/winning_event_key/winning_kind/occurred_at/recorded_at), never the raw event's own corrects/into/rule_version/effective fields. winning_kind is restricted to upsert/correct because those are the only two kinds fold() ever resolves a live winner from (tombstone/merged_into/unmerged never appear here). See export_events_tombstoned_row.schema.json for the sibling status=tombstoned shape, which carries a different field set again.
